verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms BVNK serves an llms.txt at docs.bvnk.com (HTTP 200) titled 'BVNK API Documentation' and describing itself as complete API documentation. Its content covers substantive topics such as Hawk authentication and partner markup fees, and individual doc pages are also served as raw .md files that agents can ingest. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/agent-oriented docs offering (e.g., an llms-full.txt or agent usage guidance), independent community corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: HTTP 200 at https://docs.bvnk.com/llms.txt # BVNK API Documentation
BVNK uses **Hawk authentication** for secure API access.
As a partner, you can add a markup fee to your customers' transactions
